The '''Rengali Imperial Naval Academy''' was one of the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Academies]]<ref name="Zal" /> used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to train its [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Naval]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]].<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Imperial [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ralchio Nervi/Legends|Ralchio Nervi]] attended the Academy after [[Marriage/Legends|marrying]] [[Lila Nervi/Legends|Lila Nervi]]. The captain graduated with mediocre marks, but held records for winning head-to-head combat simulations.<ref name="Friends Like These">''[[Friends Like These]]''</ref>

The [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Zal Artha]] also attended the Academy<ref name="Zal" /> at some point by [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{FFG|story=Takeover at Whisper Base (adventure)|book=Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beginner Game|text=''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Beginner Game}}, in which [[Zal Artha]] appears as a graduate of the Rengali [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Naval]] [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Academy]] according to Artha's character folio, is set within weeks of [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> and performed with distinction during her [[Time/Legends|time]] there. However, as a woman, Artha faced harassment and derision from the Academy's instructors and students<ref name="Zal" /> due to the institutional [[High Human Culture/Legends|bias]] toward male [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="EGW" /> When Artha graduated, she was passed over for promotion as part of the continued bias. Another reason for the pilot's lack of promotion was due to fears by [[Naval Command (Imperial)|Naval Command]] that Artha sympathized with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], given that she was a [[Chandrilan/Legends|native]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]],<ref name="Zal" /> a hotbed of dissent.<ref name="EGW" /> Artha eventually defected to the Alliance to become a [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]].<ref name="Zal" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rengali Imperial Naval Academy was first mentioned in a character folio for Zal Artha that was included with [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beginner Game|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Beginner Game]] boxed set.<ref name="Zal">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beginner Game|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Beginner Game]]</ref>
